chapter.title: The Stratford Tower
chapter.note: Rebuilt on 6 November 2026 from the PowerPyx 100% chart (104 boxes), the detroitbecometext template and the Fandom wiki: the lobby ruse with the desk clues, floor 47 and its magazines, the server room door and the IT employee, the climb (no failure), the corridor guards (RUSE with its timing check, or ASSAULT and the choice of guard), the operator, the five-part speech, the SWAT breach only when an alarm was raised, Simon’s rescue and the roof, the jump and the news report with the template’s public-opinion lines. Markus, North and Josh cannot die; Simon can. Each entry says how the benchmark implements it. Researched in docs/research/ch23-the-stratford-tower.md.

decisions.title: Find a way to pass security
decisions.context: The Stratford Tower lobby: an android receptionist and her human supervisor at the front desk.

options.label: Talk to the android receptionist
options.effect: Optional grey node: she offers help and Markus declines.

options.label: Analyze the supervisor’s desk
options.effect: Five clues: smart watch, daughter Emily, name, parking badge, home address.

benchmark.note: The prologue (ALONE IN FERNDALE to MARKUS EXPLAINS HIS PLAN) is one event (M10p); the optional receptionist talk is a decision (M10l); the desk analysis is an event whose five clues are facts and unlock the ruses (M10d).

decisions.title: Call supervisor: which ruse?
decisions.context: Markus phones the supervisor to get her away from the desk.

options.label: PARKING (pose as parking attendant)
options.effect: Someone backed into her car. No stat change.

options.label: SCHOOL (pose as teacher)
options.effect: Her daughter Emily has a fever. No stat change.

options.label: FIRE DEPARTMENT (pose as fireman)
options.effect: A fire in her building. No stat change.

decisions.gate: Each option needs its desk clue (parking badge, daughter, home address).
decisions.note: The wiki: no mechanical effect; the ruses differ in how much distress they cause.

benchmark.note: Template PROMPT 1 with its three bracketed buttons; every path leads to SUPERVISOR LEAVES, then the converted receptionist and the elevator (event M10r).

decisions.title: Distract the server-room guards
decisions.context: Floor 47: two guards block the server room.

options.label: Hack robot
options.effect: Guards distracted.

options.label: Hack dispenser
options.effect: Guards distracted.

benchmark.note: AT FLOOR 47 (event M10f), the cafeteria magazines and TV (media R23), the disguise steps (event M10g), then the hack choice (M10h). No stat change.

decisions.title: Lock the server room door?
decisions.context: North: “Check the door first to make sure no one else gets in.”

options.label: Forget to lock the door
options.effect: The IT employee walks in and is left to be found: the alarm is raised.

options.label: Lock the door
options.effect: Nobody comes in; one of three conditions for no SWAT team.

benchmark.note: No button in the game; offered as two actions in the chart’s order.

decisions.title: The IT employee

options.label: ALIBI
options.effect: North stuns him; North −1.

options.label: GAIN TIME
options.effect: North stuns him; North −1.

options.label: DRAW GUN
options.effect: Markus stuns him; North −1 (the wiki says none).

decisions.gate: Only when the door was left unlocked.

benchmark.note: Template PROMPT 2; the template’s North −1 covers the whole unlocked-door block. Then the climb (event M10k, no failure) and the top floor (event M10t).

decisions.title: Security blocks the way: ruse or assault?
decisions.context: Two guards at the security desk before the broadcast room. Josh: “No killing.” North: “Our cause is more important.”

options.label: RUSE
options.effect: North −1, Josh +1. In time: guards knocked out, Jericho +1. Too slow (risk 0.2, unsourced): central alerted, North attacks, Simon shot; Jericho −1, Simon −1.

options.label: ASSAULT
options.effect: Josh −1, North +1, Jericho +1; Markus draws and picks a guard.

benchmark.note: Template PROMPT 3. The timing check is the RUSE’s risk.

decisions.title: Draw gun: which guard?
decisions.context: ASSAULT: one guard is at the phone, the other draws his weapon.

options.label: Shoot guard on phone
options.effect: He dies; the other shoots Simon (Jericho −1, Simon −1); no alarm.

options.label: Shoot guard drawing weapon
options.effect: He dies; the other alerts central security: alarm.

benchmark.note: The old engine rolled for Simon’s wound; the game lets the player pick the guard.

decisions.title: Shoot the fleeing operator?
decisions.context: The human operator runs for the alarm. North: “Shoot him!” Josh: “Don’t kill him!”

options.label: SHOOT
options.effect: He dies; North +1, Josh −1. A casualty for the news.

options.label: SPARE
options.effect: He raises the alarm; North −1, Josh +1.

benchmark.note: Template PROMPT 4. Public opinion moves only at MEDIA REACTS.

decisions.title: Prepare to broadcast
decisions.context: Markus sends the android operators away and broadcasts with his face’s skin off. “Ready.”

options.label: Ready
options.effect: Jericho +1, North +1 on every path.

benchmark.note: Narrated event with the unconditional arrows.

options.label: CALM
options.effect: Spoken line only.

options.label: DETERMINED
options.effect: Spoken line only.

decisions.title: The broadcast: first demand
decisions.context: Recognition, end of slavery, equal rights or freedom of speech.

options.label: RECOGNITION
options.effect: No effect.

options.label: END OF SLAVERY
options.effect: No effect.

options.label: EQUAL RIGHTS
options.effect: No effect.

options.label: FREEDOM OF SPEECH
options.effect: No effect.

decisions.title: The broadcast: second demand
decisions.context: Justice, segregation, work or civil rights.

options.label: JUSTICE
options.effect: No effect.

options.label: SEGREGATION
options.effect: No effect.

options.label: WORK
options.effect: No effect.

options.label: CIVIL RIGHTS
options.effect: No effect.

decisions.title: The broadcast: third demand
decisions.context: Property, means of reproduction or territory.

options.label: RIGHT TO PROPERTY
options.effect: Picks the news line on the demands.

options.label: MEANS OF REPRODUCTION
options.effect: Picks the news line on the demands.

options.label: TERRITORY
options.effect: Picks the news line on the demands.

benchmark.note: Template PROMPT 8; no arrow; changes one MEDIA REACTS line.

decisions.title: The broadcast: ending
decisions.context: PEACEFUL or DETERMINED; then the SWAT team storms the room if any alarm was raised.

options.label: PEACEFUL
options.effect: With nobody killed, public opinion +2 at MEDIA REACTS; otherwise −2.

options.label: DETERMINED
options.effect: Public opinion −2 at MEDIA REACTS.

benchmark.note: Template PROMPT 9. SWAT TEAM STORMS ROOM (Jericho −1, Simon hit) only when the door was left unlocked, central security was alerted, or the operator was spared; otherwise LEAVE BROADCAST ROOM. The old engine played the breach on every run.

decisions.title: Simon damaged by the SWAT team: help or flee?

options.label: HELP
options.effect: Quick-time event (risk 0.15, unsourced): saved and carried to the roof, or SWAT kills him. No arrow.

options.label: FLEE
options.effect: SWAT kills Simon; Jericho −1.

decisions.gate: Only when the SWAT team stormed the room.

benchmark.note: Template PROMPT 10. Listed HELP first (the sources list FLEE first) so shared regression paths keep their default.

decisions.title: Simon can’t continue: leave or kill him?
decisions.context: On the roof, Simon cannot jump. North: “We have to shoot him.” Josh: “That’s murder!”

options.label: LEAVE
options.effect: Simon left alive on the roof (simonHidden); North −1, Josh +1, Simon +2.

options.label: KILL > SHOOT
options.effect: Simon executed; North +1, Josh −1.

options.label: KILL > REFRAIN
options.effect: Same outcome as LEAVE, no arrow.

decisions.gate: Only after SWAT > HELP > Simon saved.

benchmark.note: Template PROMPTS 11 and 12, in the chart’s order (LEAVE SIMON above EXECUTE SIMON).

decisions.title: Run to jump
decisions.context: The way off the roof is a parachute jump.

options.label: Reach roof edge
options.effect: Jump.

options.label: Get shot
options.effect: Too slow under SWAT fire (risk 0.05, unsourced); North helps Markus jump; Markus’s blue blood is left for Public Enemy.

decisions.gate: Every path; the risk only when the SWAT team came.

benchmark.note: One action with a timer as its risk; GET SHOT sets stratfordMarkusShot.

options.label: THE GROUP ESCAPED
options.effect: Simon escaped with them (only with no SWAT team).

options.label: THE GROUP ESCAPED BUT SIMON WAS LEFT BEHIND
options.effect: Simon left alive on the roof.

options.label: THE GROUP ESCAPED BUT SIMON WAS DESTROYED
options.effect: Killed by the SWAT team or executed.

benchmark.note: Public opinion: nobody killed +2, otherwise −1; peaceful ending with nobody killed +2, otherwise −2. The ending label is stored in stratfordEnding.
